title: Make ibogaine assessment available
understoodAs: Remove the page-level hold that blocks the entire assessment when ibogaine is selected. Keep the informational assessment accessible, preserve the existing hard-stop score pause for cardiac and other flagged answers, and retain holds for medicines whose safety data has not been reviewed.
summary: Removed the page-wide block for the ibogaine assessment link so the informational Index opens. Cardiac hard-stop scoring and the 14 unreviewed-medicine holds remain. The preview build and CI checks pass; mobile visual QA was not completed.

beforeAfter.label: Ibogaine assessment link
beforeAfter.before: Opening ?m=ibogaine shows a temporary safety-hold page and blocks the Index.
beforeAfter.after: Opening ?m=ibogaine shows the Index with the Begin Assessment option. The questionnaire's cardiac hard-stop remains active.
